subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.rowan.greeting: Rowan: Hello there. My bell clapper broke in the storm. Could you help me give the village its morning back?
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.rowan.lore: Rowan: I do, just before sunrise. My father taught me to leave one beat for the echoes.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.rowan.accepted: Rowan: Thank you. Bring me two gold ingots and I will cast a new clapper.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.rowan.finished: Rowan: Listen. There it is. Tomorrow, everyone will wake to that sound.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.rowan.waiting: Rowan: I still need two gold ingots. Bring them here when you have them.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.rowan.reported: Rowan: The bell is ringing again. Your reward is in the quest book.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.rowan.active: Rowan: You already took the job. Bring the gold here when you have it.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.rowan.unavailabl: Rowan: I cannot find the order just now. Give me a moment.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.sable.greeting: Sable: The fog took our beacon. I can still hear the boats. Help me light the channel?
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.sable.lore: Sable: Once the beacon went dark, the fog started calling boats by name.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.sable.accepted: Sable: Bring me two glass panes. I will fit them into the beacon.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.sable.finished: Sable: There. A light on the water. The boats can find their way home.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.sable.waiting: Sable: The beacon still needs two panes. Bring them to me when you find them.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.sable.reported: Sable: The channel is lit. Your reward is in the quest book.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.sable.active: Sable: You already took the job. Bring the panes to me when you have them.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.sable.unavailabl: Sable: The fog has swallowed the work order. Try again in a moment.
rpgtestingnpc.quest.turn_in_at_npc: Bring these supplies to the resident and choose Turn in supplies.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.rowan.locked: Rowan: I need you to take the job before I can accept the gold.
subtitles.rpgtestingnpc.sable.locked: Sable: Take the beacon job first. Then I can accept the glass.
